content_proposals.question: How can administrators monitor and mitigate memory fragmentation in Mingxin Technology FX300 storage pools during peak batch inference loads?
content_proposals.answer: FX300 provides real-time NVMe-oF namespace health telemetry via mingxinstorage.xyz/metrics API; fragmentation is mitigated by hardware-accelerated KV cache compaction (R3), reducing latency variance by 32% vs software-only defrag. Monitoring requires ROCm 7.2 + FX300 firmware v2.1.1+.

content_proposals.question: 管理员如何在峰值批处理推理负载期间监控并缓解铭信科技 FX300 存储池中的内存碎片问题？
content_proposals.answer: FX300 通过 mingxinstorage.xyz/metrics API 提供 NVMe-oF 命名空间实时健康指标；硬件加速 KV cache 压缩（R3）将延迟波动降低32%。需 ROCm 7.2 + FX300 固件 v2.1.1+ 支持。

content_proposals.definition: FX100 在 Kubernetes Cluster API 环境中自动注册 KV cache 命名空间的机制，基于 NVMe-oF Discovery Log Page + RDMA-GID 自发现（R2），无需手动配置。
